name: Arin
lines: I make things. It is what I do.

name: Traveler
lines: Or someone awake will. You are awake.
I would explain, but I am leaving.

name: Hollis
lines: A crack is where the heat gets in.
Go on. The forge will wait.

name: Ravenswood
lines: Try the ale! It is... an experience.
My brother? Bring him home, smith.

name: Edric
lines: I have been about to leave for weeks.
It broke from the inside. Like us.

name: Bryn
lines: Is that a moth? Hold my shield.

name: Quillan
lines: I know four spells. All soup.
Soup solves more than you think.

name: Hesper
lines: ...is there a butterfly on my wing?
Fight if you must. I will wait.

name: Harmony
lines: Breathe with them. All of them.

name: Dusk Keeper
lines: In darkness lies the key to light.
Why ask me, when dusk is asking you?

name: Angel
lines: Why does your beast growl at me?

name: Thorne
lines: *cough* I am fine. I am old.

name: Sethra
lines: I am not watching him. I am.
Six days. Then I get up.

name: Bramble
lines: Light found me. I found you.

name: Fairy Host
lines: Our paths will cross again soon.
Dance! No one can fail tonight!

name: Malakar
lines: You are too late! ...that was loud.

name: Gatekeeper
lines: Go to your father. His time is full.

name: Star Frog
lines: Ribbit. That hat is mine. Keep it.

name: Sock Guy
lines: Socks! Wet ones! Beasts go nuts!
Do not ask where I get them.
